```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Internet has unleashed innovation, enabled growth, and inspired freedom more rapidly and extensively than any other technological advance in human history.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Internet offers a communications system uniquely free from government intervention.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The group supports removing regulatory barriers that protect outdated technologies and business plans from innovation and competition.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The group supports preventing legacy regulation from interfering with new and disruptive technologies such as mobile delivery of voice video data as they become crucial components of the Internet ecosystem.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The group will resist any effort to shift control away from the successful multi-stakeholder approach of Internet governance and toward governance by international or other intergovernmental organizations.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The group supports ensuring that personal data receives full constitutional protection from government overreach.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The group supports ensuring that individuals retain the right to control the use of their data by third parties.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The group believes the only way to safeguard or improve these systems is through the private sector.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"One-sixth of the American economy is regulated by the federal government on precedents from the nineteenth century.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Today's technology and telecommunications industries are overseen by the Federal Communications Commission, established in 1934.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Federal Communications Commission was given jurisdiction over telecommunications formerly assigned to the Interstate Commerce Commission, which had been created in 1887 to regulate the railroads.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The development of telecommunications advances so rapidly that even the Telecom Act of 1996 is woefully out of date.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The industry invested $66 billion in 2011.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The industry needs and deserves a more modern relationship with the federal government for the benefit of consumers here and worldwide.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
